query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM central.steps WHERE id = $1) AS "steps!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.step_attempts WHERE id = $2) AS "attempts!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.events WHERE id = $3) AS "events!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.outbox WHERE workspace_id = $4 AND deduplication_key = 'execution.test:k1') AS "outbox!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.execution_command_receipts WHERE workspace_id = $4 AND command_scope = 'execution.test' AND idempotency_key = 'k1') AS "receipts!"
